description: Migrate AspeQt Android build to target Android 16 (API 36), fixing crashes, deprecated APIs, and scoped storage compliance

userStories.title: Add android:exported to activity and opt out of predictive back
userStories.description: As a user on Android 12+, I need the app manifest to declare exported and back-gesture attributes so the app installs and navigates correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: In android/AndroidManifest.xml, add android:exported="true" to the SerialActivity <activity> element (it has MAIN/LAUNCHER and USB intent filters)
In android/AndroidManifest.xml, add android:enableOnBackInvokedCallback="false" to the <application> element to opt out of predictive back on API 36
Project compiles without errors

userStories.title: Fix PendingIntent mutability flag for USB permissions
userStories.description: As a user connecting a USB SIO2PC device on Android 12+, I need the USB permission request to not crash.
acceptanceCriteria: In android/src/net/greblus/SIO2PCUS4A.java around line 84, add PendingIntent.FLAG_MUTABLE to the PendingIntent.getBroadcast() call
Project compiles without errors

userStories.title: Fix BroadcastReceiver export flag for API 33+
userStories.description: As a user on Android 13+, I need the USB broadcast receiver to be registered with the correct export flag so it doesn't crash.
acceptanceCriteria: In android/src/net/greblus/SerialActivity.java, in the RegisterReceiverRunnable.run() method (around line 242), add API-level check: use Context.RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED flag on Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU, fall back to no-flag registration on older APIs
Project compiles without errors

userStories.title: Fix deprecated getParcelableExtra call
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to use the type-safe API for extracting parcelable extras on API 33+.
acceptanceCriteria: In android/src/net/greblus/SerialActivity.java, in the USBReceiver.onReceive() method (around line 251), add API-level check: use intent.getParcelableExtra(UsbManager.EXTRA_DEVICE, UsbDevice.class) on API 33+, fall back to the old overload on older APIs
Project compiles without errors

userStories.title: Fix string comparison bug in file dialog
userStories.description: As a user, I need file dialog cancellation to be detected correctly using .equals() instead of == / !=.
acceptanceCriteria: In android/src/net/greblus/SerialActivity.java around lines 120 and 140, replace != string comparisons with !"Cancelled".equals(m_chosen) (or equivalent .equals() pattern)
All string comparisons against literal strings in SerialActivity.java use .equals()
Project compiles without errors

userStories.title: Update Bluetooth permissions in manifest for API 31+
userStories.description: As a user on Android 12+, I need the correct Bluetooth permissions declared so Bluetooth functionality is not silently blocked.
acceptanceCriteria: In android/AndroidManifest.xml, add android:maxSdkVersion="30" to the existing BLUETOOTH and BLUETOOTH_ADMIN permissions
Add uses-permission for BLUETOOTH_CONNECT
Add uses-permission for BLUETOOTH_SCAN with android:usesPermissionFlags="neverForLocation"
Project compiles without errors

userStories.title: Add runtime BLUETOOTH_CONNECT permission request
userStories.description: As a user on Android 12+, I need the app to request BLUETOOTH_CONNECT at runtime before Bluetooth operations.
acceptanceCriteria: In android/src/net/greblus/SerialActivity.java, add a static method (e.g. requestBluetoothPermission()) that checks Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 31 and calls requestPermissions() for BLUETOOTH_CONNECT if not already granted
Call this method from changeDevice() or the SIO2BT constructor before any Bluetooth API calls
Handle the permission result in onRequestPermissionsResult() in SerialActivity
Project compiles without errors
userStories.notes: Depends on US-006 for manifest permissions

userStories.title: Replace programmatic Bluetooth enable with system intent
userStories.description: As a user on Android 13+, I need the app to prompt me to enable Bluetooth via a system dialog instead of silently enabling it.
acceptanceCriteria: In android/src/net/greblus/SIO2BT.java, remove both calls to m_BluetoothAdapter.enable() (in constructor line 35 and openDevice() line 45)
Replace with a call to SerialActivity that launches an ACTION_REQUEST_ENABLE intent
In android/src/net/greblus/SerialActivity.java, add a static method to launch the Bluetooth enable intent and handle the result in onActivityResult()
The busy-wait loop in SIO2BT.openDevice() (line 47: while (!m_BluetoothAdapter.isEnabled()) {}) should wait for the intent result rather than spinning
Project compiles without errors

userStories.title: Update manifest storage permissions for scoped storage
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the manifest updated for scoped storage compliance before implementing SAF.
acceptanceCriteria: In android/AndroidManifest.xml, remove android:requestLegacyExternalStorage="true" from the application element
Add android:maxSdkVersion="28" to WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE and READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permissions
In android/src/net/greblus/SerialActivity.java, remove the runtime permission request for WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE in onCreate() (lines 62-67) since it is no longer needed on modern APIs
Project compiles without errors

userStories.title: Replace file open chooser with SAF ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT
userStories.description: As a user on Android 11+, I need to open ATR/XFD/PRO/XEX/CAS/ASPEQT files using the system file picker since raw filesystem browsing is blocked.
acceptanceCriteria: In android/src/net/greblus/SerialActivity.java, replace the fileChooser() method: instead of creating a SimpleFileDialog, launch an ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT intent with type */* (Atari file types have no standard MIME)
Add onActivityResult() override to SerialActivity to handle the file picker result
In onActivityResult(), extract the content URI from the returned intent, call takePersistableUriPermission() with FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION
Copy the selected file from the content URI (via ContentResolver.openInputStream()) to the app's cache directory so existing C++ code can use a regular file path
Set m_chosen to the cache file path (not the content URI) so the existing C++ polling loop in mainwindow.cpp and diskeditdialog.cpp continues to work unchanged
Remove the FileChooser Runnable class (no longer needed) or repurpose it to launch the intent
Project compiles without errors
userStories.notes: Depends on US-009. This handles the 'file open' path. The C++ side polls SerialActivity.m_chosen via JNI and expects a file path string. By copying to app cache, we preserve that contract. Call sites: mainwindow.cpp lines 1344-1357 (disk images), 1870-1885 (session open), 1960-1974 (boot exe), 2008-2019 (cassette), diskeditdialog.cpp 680-692 (add files).

userStories.title: Replace file save chooser with SAF ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT
userStories.description: As a user on Android 11+, I need to save disk images and session files using the system file picker.
acceptanceCriteria: In android/src/net/greblus/SerialActivity.java, when runFileChooser() is called with action==1 (FileSave), launch ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT instead of ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT
Set the intent MIME type to application/octet-stream and use putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TITLE, ...) with a default filename if available
Handle the save result in onActivityResult() — extract the content URI and convert it to a usable file path
For save: the C++ code writes to a file path, so either write to cache first and copy to the content URI afterwards, or get a ParcelFileDescriptor and convert to a path via /proc/self/fd/
Set m_chosen to the path the C++ code should write to
Project compiles without errors
userStories.notes: Depends on US-010. Call sites: mainwindow.cpp lines 1630-1641 (save disk image as), 1924-1936 (save session).

userStories.title: Replace folder chooser with SAF ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE
userStories.description: As a user on Android 11+, I need to select folders for folder images and file extraction using the system folder picker.
acceptanceCriteria: In android/src/net/greblus/SerialActivity.java, replace the dirChooser() method: instead of creating a SimpleFileDialog with FolderChoose, launch an ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE intent
Handle the folder result in onActivityResult() — extract the tree URI
Call takePersistableUriPermission() with FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION | FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION on the tree URI
Convert the tree URI to a file path that the C++ code can use (via DocumentFile and ContentResolver, or by resolving the underlying path if on primary storage)
Set m_chosen to the resolved folder path
Remove the DirChooser Runnable class or repurpose it to launch the intent
Project compiles without errors
userStories.notes: Depends on US-010. Call sites: mainwindow.cpp lines 1384-1397 (mount folder image), diskeditdialog.cpp lines 618-631 (extract files to dir). The C++ folderimage.cpp code reads directory contents with standard file I/O, so the resolved path must be a real filesystem path.

userStories.title: Fix QTime midnight wraparound bug in serial port timeouts
userStories.description: As a user, I need serial port timeouts to work correctly at all times including across midnight.
acceptanceCriteria: In serialport-android.cpp around line 342, replace QTime startTime = QTime::currentTime() with QElapsedTimer timer; timer.start(); and change the elapsed check (line 354) from QTime::currentTime().msecsTo(startTime) to -timer.elapsed()
In serialport-android.cpp around line 390, apply the same QElapsedTimer replacement for the write timeout loop (line 408)
Add #include <QElapsedTimer> at the top of the file and remove #include <QTime> if no longer used
All timeout logic in serialport-android.cpp uses QElapsedTimer instead of QTime
Project compiles without errors

userStories.title: Migrate theme from Holo to Material
userStories.description: As a user, I want the app to use a modern Android theme instead of the outdated Holo theme.
acceptanceCriteria: In android/AndroidManifest.xml, change android:theme="@android:style/Theme.Holo" to @android:style/Theme.Material.Light (no extra dependencies needed)
Project compiles without errors
userStories.notes: Using @android:style/Theme.Material.Light avoids needing AppCompat or Material Components library dependencies

userStories.title: Verify edge-to-edge display compliance for API 36
userStories.description: As a user on Android 16, I need the app UI to not be obscured by system bars since edge-to-edge is mandatory.
acceptanceCriteria: Review the Qt Android platform plugin behavior for system bar insets
If Qt does not handle insets automatically, add window insets handling in SerialActivity.java to ensure the Qt rendering surface is not obscured by status bar or navigation bar
Add a comment in SerialActivity.java documenting the edge-to-edge status (whether Qt handles it or manual adjustment was needed)
Project compiles without errors
userStories.notes: Since this is a Qt app, the Qt rendering surface may handle edge-to-edge automatically. This story is primarily investigation and verification.
